title: How to reset a VPN client certificate
content: If the VPN client reports that the certificate has expired, open the certificate store, delete the entry issued by the BOMS corporate CA, then run the repair tool shipped with the client. The client requests a fresh certificate on the next connection. If the error persists, raise a service request of type Incident with priority High and attach the client log file.

title: Access request approval process
content: Every access request needs one approval from the department head of the requesting employee. Approvers receive the request with status Pending and must record an approval decision together with a comment. Approved requests are provisioned within two working days; rejected requests are closed automatically.
